```{r}

raw <- read_csv("~/Documents/R/scouting2026/shinyapp/data/mdbet/data.csv")

data <- raw |>
    mutate(scout_key = paste(match, robot, team))

data <- data |>
    mutate(auto_climb = ifelse(
        data$scout_key %in% temp$scout_key, 
        temp[temp$scout_key == scout_key, ]$auto_climb, "No")) |>
    mutate(endgame_climb = ifelse(
        data$scout_key %in% temp$scout_key, 
        temp[temp$scout_key == scout_key, ]$endgame_climb, "No"))

view(data)
```
